stages.event: You arrive at the Graveyard, a place rumored to be haunted by the spirits of ancient pets.

choices.1: Charge in with a fierce roar (ATT).
choices.3: Try to sense any malevolent energy (ENE).

stages.event: You take a moment to survey your surroundings, noticing the eerie atmosphere and the crypts scattered around.

choices.1: Search for any signs of hidden dangers (DEF).
choices.2: Attempt to communicate with the spirits (INT).
choices.3: Follow your nose to see if you can sniff out any food (HAP).

stages.event: You hear the growling of a %%HOSTILE_PET%% approaching. Your instincts tell you to run.

choices.1: Make a dash for that nearby crypt (ATT).
choices.2: Quickly analyze the terrain to find the best escape route (INT).
choices.3: Use your agility to leap over obstacles (DEX).

stages.event: You face a particularly fierce %%HOSTILE_PET%%. You must confront it head-on!

choices.1: Try to intimidate it with your roar (ATT).
choices.2: Use your intelligence to come up with a clever tactic (INT).
choices.3: Run away as fast as you can (ENE).

stages.stage_name: Locating a FREE to open Loot Chest
stages.event: You stumble upon a suspicious-looking chest in the Graveyard. Is it a treasure trove or a trap?

choices.1: Smash it open with brute force (ATT).
choices.2: Carefully inspect the lock for traps (DEX).
choices.3: Hope for the best and give it a kick (HAP)

stages.stage_name: Locating a FREE to open Loot Chest
stages.event: You find a genuine chest in the Graveyard. It's old and creaky, but it might contain treasure!

choices.1: Try to force the lock open with your paws (ATT).
choices.2: Use your agility to navigate any traps (DEX).
choices.3: Hope the lock is weak and easily opens (HAP).

stages.event: You've collected all you need in the Graveyard. It's time to leave.

choices.1: Make a hasty exit through the nearest gate (ATT).
choices.2: Take a moment to appreciate the beauty of the Graveyard (INT).
choices.3: Linger to see if you can find any more hidden treasures (HAP).
